A man claiming to be 19 years old has been arrested at Gumbihini, a suburb of Tamale, for allegedly impersonating a Ghana Prisons Service officer.
The suspect, identified as Mohammed Yussif Zanjina, was arrested on Tuesday, November 17, at about 9:50 a.m. for allegedly wearing the Prisons Service's No. 4 camouflage uniform without authorisation.
According to a statement published by the Ghana Prisons Service on Facebook, the arrest was carried out by a Rapid Response Team led by Chief Officer Ahmed Mashood.
The operation followed intelligence provided by Lance Corporal Haruna Mohammed Sherif.
The suspect was subsequently presented to the Acting Second-in-Command of Tamale Central Prison, CSP Benedict Sanziri, for further interrogation.
He was later handed over to the Regional Police Crime Officer for further investigations.
CSP Sanziri commended L/Cpl Haruna Mohammed Sherif for providing the intelligence that led to the arrest and praised the Rapid Response Team for its swift response.
The circumstances surrounding the alleged impersonation and the suspect's motive were not immediately disclosed.
